market.what: wine cork stoppers (natural + technical), world; TCA control is built into price
market.method: Amorim stoppers EUR 713M (75.9% of 939M) / 42% unit share (5.5 of 13 bn) = ~EUR 1.7B = $1.83B; NDtech TCA-screened cork EUR 500/1000 vs EUR 300-400 plain
market.job_what: TCA removal/screening of cork stoppers (steam, supercritical CO2, per-cork GC screening) plus TCA remediation of wine, world
market.job_method: est.: NDtech ~50M corks x ~EUR 0.15 premium = EUR 8M + Diam ~2 bn closures x ~EUR 0.015 Diamant treatment (est.) = EUR 30M + steam/screening on ~11 bn other stoppers x ~EUR 0.003 (est.) = EUR 33M + wine remediation <EUR 5M = ~EUR 75M = ~$90M; low confidence

value.logic: est.: 13 bn corks x ~1% tainted x ~$12/bottle = ~$1.6B lost/yr; scavenger in closure or bulk wine cuts 50% = $0.8B
value.revenue_logic: 1 bn stoppers (8%) x $0.01 add-in (vs NDtech premium EUR 0.10-0.20) = $10M; + bulk TCA/TBA wine remediation ~$1M
value.margin_logic: additive sold to cork makers; tiny dose per stopper

trend.drivers: wine consumption down (214 Mhl 2024, ~208 Mhl 2025); premium and sparkling wines (TCA felt at 0.5 ng/L) push zero-TCA demand

indirect_startups: amaea (NZ, 2011; MIP wine filtration platform, could extend)
competition.notes: Cork makers own the fix (thermal desorption up to 99%, per-cork GC screening). No 2012+ startup with a TCA binder found. Yeast-wall fining removes ~60-78% haloanisoles.

lab.synth: 1-2 step custom host (cavitand/cyclodextrin-type), 3 variants; s0 not set yet
lab.test: TCA-spiked wine 2-10 ng/L, SPME-GC-MS/MS (ETS/AWRI); releasable TCA cork soak ISO 20752; aroma GC-MS; sensory triangle ISO 4120
lab.logic: synth 6 wk ~$15k; 4 wk tests: 40 x ~$150 = $6k (est.), sensory ~$5k, cork soak trials ~$4k

sale.gates: co-development with a cork maker; food-contact (EU 1935/2004, FDA FCN ~1 yr); 12-mo bottle-aging trials
